issues.title: Code line truncation
issues.description: Diff lines truncate horizontally with ellipses rather than permitting horizontal scroll.
issues.evidence: Lines 13 and 14 clip identifiers to 'shouldArchive(...' and 'RETENTION_...'.
issues.suggestion: Enable horizontal scrolling for diff content on mobile viewports.
issues.triageNote: Verified in source: code span used whitespace-nowrap + overflow-hidden + text-ellipsis with 104px of fixed w-10/w-10/w-6 gutters, so ~32 mono chars fit at 390px and longer lines ellipsize. Fixed by narrowing gutters below sm (w-8 sm:w-10) and switching code to whitespace-pre-wrap + break-words with a hanging indent (pl-4 -indent-4), rows min-h-6 so wrapped rows grow; also fixed unflagged pair-064 note — hunk-header bg-neutral-50 is token-identical to default-background in BOTH themes, changed to bg-neutral-100 so the band is visible in light and dark.
